WITH schedule AS (
                SELECT schedule_id, project_id, warehouse_id, queue_name, payload
                FROM task_schedule
                WHERE schedule_id = $1
            ),
            inserted AS (
                INSERT INTO task (
                    task_id,
                    queue_name,
                    status,
                    warehouse_id,
                    scheduled_for,
                    task_data,
                    entity_id,
                    entity_type,
                    project_id
                )
                SELECT
                    $2,
                    s.queue_name,
                    'scheduled',
                    s.warehouse_id,
                    now(),
                    s.payload,
                    s.schedule_id,
                    CASE WHEN s.warehouse_id IS NULL THEN 'project'::entity_type
                        ELSE 'warehouse'::entity_type END,
                    s.project_id
                FROM schedule s
                ON CONFLICT (project_id, warehouse_id, entity_type, entity_id, queue_name) DO NOTHING
                RETURNING task_id
            )
            SELECT
                s.project_id,
                s.warehouse_id,
                s.queue_name,
                (SELECT task_id FROM inserted) AS inserted_task_id
            FROM schedule s
